title: The Vector of Halcyon Drift
author: Ansel Fairweather
blurb: Odile Ashgrove, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
